Hello v/mcservers!

If you're looking for a straight up vanilla server with a small group of players, you've come to the right place!

KugenKraft is a simple Vanilla server with only a handful of whitelisted players. We're looking to expand the player base to around 15-20 dedicated people. We're looking for people aged 13-15 who will play at least twice a week. Obviously, we need mature people with a love for good ol' Minecraft.

The server is hosted in Seattle, but TrustyTroll (the other admin) and I live in Canada. We also have a personal Teamspeak server to communicate with the admins and other players. We're open to doing any Youtube and Twitch collabs so feel free to record on the server!

Below are the rules and a quick summary of KugenKraft.

  • Straight up Vanilla 1.8
  • Whitelist
  • No build rules
  • Personal Teamspeak server access
  • Mature and dedicated peers (13-15 years old)

Here are some links if you'd like some more information on the server or if you want to watch our live CCTV feed.

  • KugenKraft website: http://kugenkraft.com/
  • KugenKraft CCTV: http://twitch.tv/kugenkraft/

SERVER RULES

  • No Griefing
  • Be considerate of other's builds
  • Respect of everyone is key
  • You must be at least 13 years old with a maximum of 15
  • No cracked clients
  • Your Minecraft account has to be active for around two years (1.7 ish)
  • You have to speak English fluently

Breaking these rules will obviously end in a warning or ban (All the rules are pretty standard, common sense is very important!)

If you meet all the requirements please PM me with some information, we can go from there! I just need your Minecraft username, your time zone and any other information! Also, feel free to refer a friend.
